source_evidence: Player exact 'The Crownsunder independence is still relatively new, I am sure the tension will settle before your sun sets.' Carter and sister respond from their established independent family/trade concerns, not privileged political knowledge. Approximate eighty years of succession division is established world/politics/human-states.md. Carter cautious but hopeful; sister emphasizes visiting family. Ordinary shared road movement continues approximately thirty minutes to commercial crossing approach, visible freight queue; no invented actual border ruling, mandatory special permit, new encounter or payment. G1 rooted in shared cultural region and existing disputed frontier; G2 open ordinary passage; G3 routine conversation/movement no contested uncertainty yet. D320~14:00 westbound Caereth→Orsaven coach route on Crownsunder side, within frontier approach, at the approach queue of the established commercial crossing; no inspection or crossing completed. V's exact reply 'Precisely. Do you want to travel with us?' voluntarily invites existing wool carter and his adult sister to share the road. Carter accepts ordinary company at compatible loaded-wagon pace, intending to continue toward Orsaven; sister willingly accompanies through crossing but intends to visit family/graves on Ossent side and may part ways there. No paid escort, service contract, guarantee of safety, extra party supply charge, custody change, route change or military information. Two vehicles travel together for about90 minutes toward the crossing, with ordinary road conditions and local knowledge; no new random encounter (D320 social event already used), no border inspection or passage yet. Carter/sister know own family and ordinary past crossings, nothing of confidential letter, Kestrel, hidden perpetrators or party's loot provenance; no new privileged rumor. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar and own coach/four horses healthy, Elara remains Caereth. Leg planned8days D317–324, cap5, 1 encounter day D320 consecutive1; skip D320 random night check; full D320 provisions debit and rest not yet applied. Rations12/feed16, weighted LR5/6; V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 Boots of Elvenkind equipped; Mara and horses healthy. Purse3178gp4sp6cp, all authorized listed loot sales completed once, no pending 240gp offer or clerk inquiry. Sealed diplomatic invitation and limited credentials V-held, Crown intelligence commission remaining300+1300, Coris scholarly commission remaining300/800, original Kestrel exhibits unchanged, Crown copies retained; Severin assent unconfirmed. Standing V dice delegation. V tells carter 'The Crownsunder independence is still relatively new, I am sure the tension will settle before your sun sets.' Carter responds with cautious hope, noting eighty years is long for his family; sister prioritizes ordinary family visits over competing Crown claims. The two vehicles travel a further ordinary half-hour to the crossing approach queue, observing routine freight inspection ahead; no V documents shown, confidential facts revealed, fees assessed or passage granted. Await V's next action, including ordinary crossing.
